title: Russian Strikes Hit Key Power Plant in Kyiv; Zelensky Condemns Allied Warning Gap
detail: Russia struck a key power plant in Kyiv in an overnight attack. President Zelensky condemned the strike and said allied partners gave no advance warning before the assault — continuing a pattern he flagged after two consecutive nights of barrages with no intelligence sharing from Western partners.

title: Trump Vows to Broker Peace Deal Between Zelensky and Putin
detail: US President Trump vowed to broker a peace deal between Ukrainian President Zelensky and Russian President Putin as diplomatic pressure on both sides intensifies. The announcement came amid ongoing Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and continued uncertainty about a broader ceasefire framework.
